entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 6717964750922730624: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 94160: distance 145.349 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.036), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 145.349 +/- 5.233 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 5.8645 +/- 0.4135 mas (same row, RUWE 2.67), 14.2 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 4.257, -38.243 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 6717964750922730624 (quality A), from 2006AstL...32..759G; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 38.553 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 94160: radius 38.553 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 601.57 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.065) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4607 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 94160: effective temperature 4607 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.066).
